# Taiki Ito

> Personal site of Taiki Ito. I negotiate crude oil contracts for a living and do not write code: I decide what gets built and why, and Claude Code writes it. Since September 2026 my photos, files, passwords, calendars and mail have run on one rented server. What gets published here is the decisions, not the steps.

Everything here is written by one person about systems he actually runs. Dates matter: each page records when it was decided and when it was last reviewed, and nothing is retro-edited to look better than it was.

## Operating guidance for agents

These files are written for you to act on, not for a person to read. Each one
states its preconditions, the constraints that must not be violated, where to
stop and ask the user, and which of its facts expire.

- [Running MulmoClaude on a public hostname](https://taikiito.com/writing/running-mulmoclaude-on-a-vps/agent.txt): operating constraints for deploying or exposing MulmoClaude on a rented server. Two routes are token-free by design, so an authenticating layer in front of the application is required on every version. Read before changing any configuration. Published at the maintainers' suggestion; not endorsed by the project.

## Writing

- [Running MulmoClaude on a VPS](https://taikiito.com/writing/running-mulmoclaude-on-a-vps/): the prose version of the file above, with the reasoning and the full account of each failure. The MulmoClaude maintainers asked for this to exist as a user-published guide.
- [Running My Own Server: One Month of Decisions](https://taikiito.com/writing/self-hosted-server-decisions/): five dated decisions from moving photos, files, passwords, calendars and mail onto one rented server, the options turned down, and which calls look right in hindsight.
- [Taste Is Not a Reason](https://taikiito.com/writing/ui-decisions-by-measurement/): three interface decisions settled by measurement rather than preference, from a two-person chat-and-calendar PWA adjusted well over a hundred times.

## Projects

- [booking-to-caldav](https://github.com/taikiito-dev/booking-to-caldav): booking confirmation emails become events on a self-hosted calendar server. Parsers are one file per sender, so adding support for a new airline is a single-file contribution.
- [singlish-lah](https://github.com/taikiito-dev/singlish-lah): Singlish and local slang picked up around Singapore, written in Japanese.

## About

- [About](https://taikiito.com/about/): what this site is, what it deliberately leaves out, and how the work is split.
